Notation of VetResearchLMM

Source: R/common-notation.R
vlm_notation.Rd

The symbols used in the help pages and vignettes of VetResearchLMM, with their meaning and the argument or result component that holds them. The notation follows one rule throughout: scalars are upper-case letters in normal face (\(P\), \(R\)), indices lower-case italic (\(i, j\)), vectors lower-case bold (\(\mathbf{y}\), \(\boldsymbol{\beta}\)) and matrices upper-case bold (\(\mathbf{X}\), \(\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\)).

Usage

vlm_notation(format = c("table", "path", "tex"))

Arguments

format

"table" (default: a data.table with columns symbol (LaTeX), text (plain text), kind (scalar, index, vector, matrix, set, function, operator), meaning and argument), "path" (the path of notation.csv) or "tex" (the path of Notations.tex, the notation appendix used in the articles).

Value

See format.

See also

Other VetResearchLMM utilities: autoplot.vlm_result(), vlm_app(), vlm_cite(), vlm_interpret(), vlm_reference(), vlm_save(), vlm_theme()

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

vlm_notation(
    format = "table"
  )
#>                       symbol     text     kind
#>                       <char>   <char>   <char>
#>  1:                        N        N   scalar
#>  2:                        P        P   scalar
#>  3:              \\mathbf{y}        y   vector
#>  4:              \\mathbf{X}        X   matrix
#>  5:     \\boldsymbol{\\beta}     beta   vector
#>  6:              \\mathbf{Z}        Z   matrix
#>  7:              \\mathbf{u}        u   vector
#>  8:              \\mathbf{e}        e   vector
#>  9:              \\mathbf{G}        G   matrix
